name: personalas
description: Personalas – US-localized HR hiring prompts, static HTML site

scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/structure.test.js && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:html:privatumas && npm run lint:html:locales && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:html:locales: npx html-validator-cli --file lt/index.html --validator=https://html5.validator.nu/ && npx html-validator-cli --file en/index.html --validator=https://html5.validator.nu/ && npx html-validator-cli --file lt/privatumas.html --validator=https://html5.validator.nu/ && npx html-validator-cli --file en/privatumas.html --validator=https://html5.validator.nu/
